generation.scope: Two moving lines between fixed centers force a nondegenerate ternary tensor on restriction and an opposite-rank lower bound 6+a+b-r. Without pure relations the bound is twelve, each center confines other successors to a canonical twisted cubic, and there are at most two centers per position. The two critical divisors of a two-line chain are secant or tangent intersections with those cubics.

open_mathematics: Use the forced conic of pure relations at rank eight and the critical pair geometry of longer rational chains to decide the remaining branching and finite point strata.
